description.text: Match Battle came back to Happy Meals in 2023, with Pokémon from Paldea. Each held a four-card pack and a game coin of Pikachu or a Paldea Pokémon, and in the United States it ran through 16 October 2023. Six of the 15 cards are holo: Sprigatito, Fuecoco, Quaxly, Cetitan, Pikachu and Klawf.
